authority: HANDOFF-REMAINING-20261117.md §7: 'The unused/unresolved set stays honestly ambiguous until you decide unreferenced-kit = excluded-from-scope.' Evidence: .devshots/fleet/dispatch-20261116/identity-resolution.json (scripts/fleet/identity-resolve.mjs; analysis only, 3048 records).

decision.authoring-only: EXCLUDED from review scope. 1130 records whose files are referenced by authoring sources but never reach a shipped form. They are source-kit inventory, not player-facing models; no captures or fixes are owed.
decision.duplicate-of: EXCLUDED from review scope. 74 records that are byte-identical or alternate-format siblings of files already linked (and reviewed where runtime-reachable).
decision.ambiguous: REMAINS honestly ambiguous and excluded from review scope as unproven. 1784 records, overwhelmingly assets/third_party/helios_v3 source candidates, with no traced runtime or authoring link. If any later resolves to runtime-reachable, it enters scope through the standard triage route (see runtime-reachable below).
decision.runtime-reachable: IN SCOPE. 60 records reach the shipped import graph and cannot be excluded as unreferenced. Triage wave dispatched 2026-11-17 (briefs: brief-devin2-triage-algrow.md 13 alien-growth groups, brief-devin3-triage-factory.md factory groups, brief-grok-triage-presentation.md 29 presentation/inclusion_kit/nyx candidate groups): per group, trace the ordinary route, capture through it or record covered-by against the already-passed ledger entry that renders the same content, then disposition through the standard orchestrator acceptance. Groups whose visible content is fully rendered by a passed sibling entry will be dispositioned covered-by, not separately passed.

ledgerNote: Excluded records keep the `unused/unresolved` status — that status IS the excluded bucket in coverage-status.json's coverageStates. No mass status rewrite is performed; this file is the decision record. coverageStatusCounts.unused/unresolved therefore reads as: excluded(2924: authoring-only+duplicate-of+ambiguous) + in-scope-triage(60) + resolved-into-passed-entries(count grows as triage lands).
